name: tireless
description: Tireless Agent Connector — connect this agent to your Tireless cloud dev computer (tirelesscode.com): install the tireless CLI, authenticate, run commands over ssh <workspace>.tireless, open editors, share preview ports, browse the marketplace and install tools, check workspace health, manage the game port, fix clipboard paste, hand a session off to continue on the workspace, pull the workspace's work back afterwards, self-diagnose, and self-repair — including keeping the 8h cloud session alive before it expires, so a routine expiry never interrupts a task.
